title: Beyond Natural Voices: Making Trust Visible in Delivery
description: Voice assistants’ execution barriers and local agents’ operating conditions; Gates and Fei-Fei Li conversations, defensive decoys, environment-side evidence records, and Spool.

voice-reliability.verification_scope: Full original interviews; interviewees’ judgments about product direction, not a standardized performance evaluation.

local-agent.verification_scope: The author’s full account; individual experiences are not generalized into reliability or security tests.
